pitch:
Refurbished alloy wheels, set of four, 17 inch, in popular fitments (Ford, VW, Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Vauxhall sets stocked as available): £280 a set.
Cleaned, kerb damage repaired and refinished. Before and after photos of the exact set, including the bare wheel, and a photo or balancer report of the bend and crack check, are in the listing.
View and check the actual set in person before you pay; pay on collection (cash or bank transfer at handover). Tyres are not included unless the listing says so, with the tread depth stated.
Fit guaranteed against your car's PCD, offset and size: if they do not fit, full refund. 7-day return if returned undamaged and unmarked.
Seller: Good Car Club, Bexleyheath/Gillingham area. New seller, no reviews yet, so the first buyers get this price.
